description: Registered suppressions and narrowly scoped type bridges. Every live suppression must match an entry; bridge entries name their owning declaration and retirement trigger.

exceptions.reason: TanStack Router generates this file with both directives to opt generated route metadata out of authored-code lint and type analysis.
nativeAlternativesExamined: The root lint ignore excludes the generated file, but cannot remove the generator-emitted directives.
No source-level alternative exists without changing the route generator's output.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: Retire when TanStack Router stops emitting these directives or the generated route tree is no longer part of the workspace source.

typeBridges.reason: Pinned Drizzle ORM declarations import a missing Effect 4.0.5 SQL error module path, erasing query error types into any/unknown.
nativeAlternativesExamined: Effect 4.0.5 exports the matching SqlError module at effect/sql/SqlError, not effect/unstable/sql/SqlError.
Editing node_modules is not reproducible and changing Drizzle's declaration sources is outside the application package.
Unpinning Drizzle would violate the frozen dependency pin; the ambient re-export preserves the exact upstream types without runtime code.
typeBridges.retirementTrigger: Retire the bridge when an approved Drizzle release imports effect/sql/SqlError instead, then verify the package typechecks and the runtime tests pass without the alias.
